title: Select and persist outbound evidence from the loading list business screen
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Add saved-draft loading-list outbound-evidence action using existing UI/dialog infrastructure and persisted line ids. Search bounded authorized stock-out-candidates; show actual stock-out/order/customer/product/spec/base unit, approved returned quantity and remaining link capacity. Assign or explicitly clear each exact source stock-out detail through stock-out-links then reload persisted evidence. Save newly created draft before linking; do not type arbitrary ids, text-match sources or auto-link legacy rows. Respect all effective participant customer scopes; no client-side permission authority.

Preserve explicit evidence through regular loading-list edit/reopen and render original null or unavailable links accurately. Approved/cancelled documents read-only. Unit/product/customer mismatch, returned or cancelled source, stale capacity, revoked access, partial failure and network errors leave existing persisted evidence intact and retain dialog inputs; refresh from authoritative response after success and prevent duplicate clicks. Keep existing stock/finance posting semantics. Real SQL controller round-trip/atomic rejection and executable JS interaction tests plus isolated browser save-link-reopen flow or accurate environment blocker are required.
